title: Choose the player's layout
question: Three layouts for the player controls (scrub, tracks, sound to 400 %, skip intro/credits, Up Next). The world is set; this picks the composition.

options.label: Bare Picture
options.thesis: Nothing but the film: a hairline scrub on the bottom edge, title in a corner, one ⋯ button for audio, subtitles, sound and speed; Skip Intro is the only real button.
options.viewport: Full-bleed film; 2 pt scrub along the bottom with times above; title top-left; close top-right; ⋯ bottom-right opening a compact sound/tracks popover; lilac Skip Intro above the scrub.
options.risk: Pointer-first viewers must find Play/Pause by clicking the picture; track controls are one click deeper.

options.label: Corners
options.thesis: Controls gather in the four corners and leave the middle to the picture; the scrub along the bottom thickens on hover and shows scrub thumbnails.
options.viewport: Top-left title, top-right close and PiP; bottom-left play, back 10, forward 10; bottom-right audio, subtitles, sound, full screen; edge scrub with thumbnail on hover.
options.risk: Four clusters is more chrome than the picture strictly needs.

options.label: Floating Pill
options.thesis: One compact glass controller floats above the bottom edge, everything in a single row: play, ±10, scrub, time, tracks, sound; drag it anywhere.
options.viewport: A 640 pt pill centred near the bottom: ▶ ⟲10 ⟳10 | scrub | 41:02 | tracks | sound; title fades in top-left.
options.risk: Closest to QuickTime; least distinct, and the scrub is short on wide windows.

regions.label: pill: play ±10 | scrub | time | tracks | sound
